po_authorization_ref: Product-Owner authorization of 2026-08-15 for complete end-to-end Phase-6 implementation and verified LIVE-DARK validation on the DEVELOPMENT appliance, executed as four substantial milestones with automatic continuation while gates are green, from authoritative master 09e67156fb6cb286fe47fe632a368a3c4e4c6d23.
history_note: Phases 0, 1A, 1B, 2, 3, 4 and 5 are unchanged and remain ACCEPTED_AND_CLOSED, with every accepted limitation preserved and none promoted. T0044 through T0056 are unchanged. Phase 5 is FINAL for implementation purposes and is not reopened or redesigned by this phase.

guest_device_self_service.optionality: OPTIONAL PER APPLIANCE, via a persistent local setting managed from the Hotel Admin settings surface. DEFAULT OFF.
guest_device_self_service.local_first: The setting is local-first and must behave correctly with no Central Control Plane connectivity.
guest_device_self_service.when_off: The guest device-management capability is not exposed to the guest, and ordinary authentication and device-limit behaviour is unchanged.
when_on: an already authenticated guest may view ONLY devices belonging to that guest's own current authorized entitlement/subject
the guest may remove ONLY an OFFLINE device; an ONLINE device is never removable by guest self-service
the offline state is re-checked ATOMICALLY at mutation time so an offline-to-online race fails safely
removal frees that entitlement's device slot but MUST NOT delete device identity, accounting history, authorization history, audit history or any other durable evidence
no guest may identify or manipulate another guest's device by supplying a MAC, entitlement id, stay id, room number, PMS interface, profile id or any other client-chosen subject identifier
max-device, license-capacity, session, checkout/grace, post-stay and cross-PMS invariants accepted in earlier phases are preserved
management operations are auditable and appropriately throttled against abuse, without inventing unnecessary product restrictions

package_time_modes.validity_window: PRESERVED UNCHANGED -- the continuous wall-clock model. A 2-hour package activated at 10:00 expires at 12:00 whether the guest used two hours or ten minutes.
package_time_modes.aggregate_online_time: IMPLEMENTED -- the capability the FINAL contract reserved. It supports BOTH an aggregate online-time budget AND an outer calendar/hard-validity window (for example 120 online minutes valid for 7 days). Only eligible online sessions consume the shared budget; with no eligible session online the aggregate timer does not consume; idle-reaped or terminated sessions stop consuming. The FINAL contract's SHARED DEVICE-MINUTE semantics are preserved: two eligible devices online for ten minutes consume twenty aggregate minutes.
package_time_modes.termination: The entitlement terminates ATOMICALLY at the first applicable terminal condition, including aggregate online-time exhaustion, outer hard-validity expiry, data-cap exhaustion where applicable, checkout/lifecycle termination, admin termination and the other already-approved terminal conditions.
package_time_modes.safety: No replay, delayed accounting tick, counter reset, reconnect, reboot, concurrent session or multi-device use may double-count, lose time, reopen a terminal entitlement or create negative remaining time.
package_time_modes.immutability: Selectable per IMMUTABLE package revision. Existing revisions retain their original semantics and are never reinterpreted retroactively. The default and backward-compatible mode remains VALIDITY_WINDOW unless an immutable revision explicitly selects AGGREGATE_ONLINE_TIME.

dark_boundary.phase_gate: A phase-level deployment/capability gate remains OFF for acceptance even though the per-Appliance product setting exists.
dark_boundary.why_two_controls: They are different things and are deliberately not merged. The per-Appliance setting is the LONG-TERM PRODUCT CONTROL a hotel operates; the phase-level gate is only the SAFE DEPLOYMENT BOUNDARY until later activation is separately authorized. Collapsing them would mean that shipping the product control also shipped the activation.
